# Design

Keep the extension dependency-free. acp.js remains the protocol/session controller, agentpanel.html remains a CSP-strict theme-native webview, and the fake ACP agent plus DOM shim exercise both sides headlessly. ACP owns agent-native commands, modes, configuration, usage, and session metadata; Codify slash commands remain local shortcuts that deliberately feed grounded cg output back into the same agent turn.
